tools.name: list_corpora
tools.description: List every corpus in the Postgres database with id, name, and description. Use the `id` from the listing as search's corpus argument.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a RefLib corpus. Then read section IDs you need.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
